note: The one source of capability status. Local: local-real (a real local engine or service ran), local-deterministic (a fixed rule or check on fixtures, no model), local-mock (fixture or stub only), not-supported-locally. Azure: azure-ready (adapter tested at a mocked HTTP boundary, not live-tested), azure-live-verified, or null when no adapter exists.
